capabilities: Render Typst code blocks to images
Override math block rendering with Typst
Configure shared, math, and code preambles
Compile via WebAssembly on desktop and mobile
extras: The WebAssembly file is downloaded automatically on first enable and after updates; compiler panics can require a restart, and image scaling is a known limitation.
intentEvidence: The plugin can render typst inside math blocks!
problem: Obsidian's math blocks only render LaTeX-style math, so notes written with Typst syntax show up as unrendered code.

relations.evidence: into images using Typst through the power of WASM

summary: Renders Typst code blocks and, optionally, math blocks into images inside notes using the Typst compiler running in WebAssembly.
